dashboards.name: COVID's Impact on NYC
dashboards.description: How the pandemic reshaped New York City — cases & deaths against the collapse and recovery of city mobility.

textConfig.content:
# When COVID emptied New York
As the waves hit, **subway ridership collapsed to ~7% of a normal day** and deaths surged. Watch the two panels line up: **cases spike → the city stops moving**, then recovers unevenly — **roads bounced back fast, transit is still catching up.** Data: NYC DOHMH + MTA.

---
*The two time-series share one axis: read them together. Cases/deaths from NYC DOHMH; mobility from MTA daily ridership (% of a comparable pre-pandemic day). Demo snapshot.*
